I’m a math tutor, so I don’t have one fixed specialty. I’m strongest in:

- Algebra
- Calculus (single and multivariable)
- Linear algebra
- Probability and statistics
- Geometry and Discrete Math
- Differential equations and basic proof-writing

I tailor explanations to your level, provide step-by-step solutions, and share practice problems and strategies. What topic or course are you working on?
Can you help me with algebra?
